title: Ox Passion Hub BBG Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Hub BBG delivers a nostalgic treat for vapers who enjoy confectionery-inspired profiles. The inhale brings a vibrant mix of mixed fruity notes, instantly recognisable and full of character. This sweet fruitiness is seamlessly woven into a classic, chewy Bubblegum base on the exhale, creating a fun and deeply satisfying flavour experience. Blended in a perfectly balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with full-bodied flavour clarity. It pairs flawlessly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.8ohm, ensuring rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently reliable everyday vape. Developed by OXVA, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts collection features expertly crafted flavours designed to perform seamlessly with modern pod kits, including OXVA's own XLIM series. Available in versatile 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths.
